findings.observation: Full framework includes concrete company statements about Copilot requiring sign-in, under13 restrictions subject to local law, and Windows account age signals. The linked September8 availability paragraph limits Windows Age APIs to Insiders now, with general availability later and CheckAgeStatusAsync a future update. Separate Family Safety fixes are reported available in latest mobile apps and web.
findings.limitation: Do not report the framework as a newly imposed universal age-verification mandate, or all Windows APIs as generally available. Independent effectiveness has not been established. Distinct family-use story possible if dated product behavior is clearly attributed and verified against support/developer documentation.

findings.observation: September9 ChrisLehane statement asks for national capability-based rules with testing, independent assessment, cybersecurity and incident reporting; supports four named California bills; says voluntary standards complement federal safeguards. A policy position, not an enacted federal law or independent proof of safety.
findings.limitation: Current California signing records supersede the statement's then-pending bill descriptions. Distinct policy story or clearly separated context for California coverage; preserve federal-versus-state distinction.
